guide.greenlantern.flash.title: The Flash
guide.greenlantern.flash:
The DC Universe keeps growing: the first new hero is §cthe Flash§r, the fastest man alive.

§6The ring§r
Craft the §6Flash Ring§r (redstone, gold and a lightning rod). Like Barry Allen's, it stores the suit: right-click or press §eG§r to put it on (cowl, suit, leggings and boots). One hero at a time: putting on the Flash suit removes the Lantern uniform and vice versa.

§6Super speed§r
With the suit, §esprint§r to start running. Keep holding §eforward§r and the speed keeps building up: it breaks the sound barrier (with a boom) after a few seconds and keeps going. Hold §eback§r to skid to a stop and §esneak§r to slow down.

§6On water and up walls§r
Fast enough, you run over water. Run into a wall and you go straight up it: §ejump§r to kick off the wall, keep going to vault over the top.

§6Super jump§r
Jump while running: the faster you are, the higher and farther you go. Speedsters take no fall damage.

§6Speed Force§r
The powers use Speed Force (yellow bar). It recharges slowly while you wear the suit, and much faster while you run.
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers.title: Flash Powers
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers:
With the Flash suit, hold §eR§r for the power wheel (tap R for the next power) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the ring) to use the selected power.

§6Tornado§r
The Flash runs in circles and the air becomes a vortex: creatures around are pulled in, lifted, spun and hurt, and thrown out when it ends. While it lasts you run around it on your own; sneak or use the power again to stop. Costs Speed Force every second.

§6Molecular Vibration§r
Pass through walls, floors and attacks. You do not fall: hold §ejump§r to rise and §esneak§r to sink. It ends when you use it again, after 10 seconds or when the Speed Force runs out, and you are always pushed out to the nearest free spot: no suffocating in walls or falling through the world.

§6Speed Force Lightning§r
Throw a bolt of lightning that arcs to up to two more enemies nearby. Throw it while running fast and it hits much harder.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.flash_ring: Redstone in the corners, gold ingots on the sides and a lightning rod in the center. The ring starts without Speed Force: put on the suit and run to charge it.
guide.greenlantern.controls_flash:
§eSprint§r (suit on): start running.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (Flash ring in hand): switch power.
